messages.subject: Error with DIANNtoMSStats
parts:
I'm receiving an error when trying to convert a fairly large DIA-NN out put to MSStats format.  I have looked into the annotation file everything looks ok to me, I could be wrong?  If I could get some help with this error that would be great.

Thanks
Craig

> JR_MSStats<-DIANNtoMSstatsFormat(JR_Raw,annotation = annotation, MBR = T) INFO [2023-08-07 19:02:51] ** Raw data from DIANN imported successfully. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:27] ** Raw data from DIANN cleaned successfully. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:27] ** Using provided annotation. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:27] ** Run labels were standardized to remove symbols such as '.' or '%'. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:27] ** Filtering on Global Q Value < 0.01 INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:35] ** MBR was used to analyze the data. Now setting names and filtering INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:35] -- LibPGQValue < 0.01 INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:35] -- LibQValue < 0.01 INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:35] ** The following options are used: - Features will be defined by the columns: PeptideSequence, PrecursorCharge, FragmentIon, ProductCharge - Shared peptides will be removed. - Proteins with a single feature will be removed. - Features with less than 3 measurements across runs will be removed. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:37] ** Sequences containing DECOY, Decoys are removed. INFO [2023-08-07 19:07:53] ** Sequences containing \+16 are removed. INFO [2023-08-07 19:08:09] ** Features with all missing measurements across runs are removed. INFO [2023-08-07 19:08:19] ** Shared peptides are removed. Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__, : Join results in 23966041 rows; more than 20631442 = nrow(x)+nrow(i). Check for duplicate key values in i each of which join to the same group in x over and over again. If that's ok, try by=.EACHI to run j for each group to avoid the large allocation. If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and data.table issue tracker for advice.

messages.subject: Re: Error with DIANNtoMSStats
parts:
Hi,

apologies for a delayed answer, I wasn't able to reproduce the issue. Related: please try removing the .d extension from Run annotation [but I was able to run the converter even prior to removing it]. 
Please make sure that you're using the latest versions of both MSstats and MSstatsConvert.
Please let me know if the problem persists.

Kind regards,
Mateusz
